market.question: Named storm forms before hurricane season?

assessment.reasoning: No named Atlantic storm reported between Dec 4 2025 and Apr 29 2026. Pre-season storms have occurred in ~30-40% of recent years but typically in May only. With ~32 days remaining and no current activity in NHC tropical outlook, probability ~18-25%.
data_sources: Wikipedia 2026 Atlantic hurricane season starts June 1
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a tropical or subtropical storm forms unexpectedly in May 2026
